debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-k-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a profile and l-e-f-t a c-h-a-r-a-c-t-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-y step.
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t a s-c-r-e-n-i-n-g m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-t-r-i-n-g and l-e-f-t a c-o-n-v-e-r-s-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-f-w-a-r-e s-a-n-i-t-y check.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-u-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and l-e-f-t t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-m-o-u-n-t l-i-m-i-t check.
4) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-e-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m n-a-m-e-s and l-e-f-t r-e-m-n-a-n-t c-o-n-t-a-c-t s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-o-g p-u-r-g-e check.
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-s-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l-e-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y check.
